title: collab: validateInboundDoc leaves flaSwfBlobs uncapped and unsanitized (memory-amplification)
description: FIXED. packages/collab/src/validate.ts flaSwfBlobs block now caps count (MAX_FLA_SWF_BLOBS=4096) AND total retained bytes (MAX_FLA_SWF_BLOB_BYTES=64 MiB), drops any entry that is not a {bytes} blob object (Uint8Array, or base64 string in the direct pre-decode form), and sanitizes non-bytes metadata while leaving the typed array untouched. Added 4 tests to validate.test.ts (count cap, total-bytes cap, non-blob drop, valid-keep+metadata-sanitize). docs/37-collab.md resource-bounds section updated. Verify: 'pnpm --filter ./packages/** build' exit 0; 'pnpm --filter @flash/collab test' => Test Files 5 passed, Tests 45 passed (validate.test.ts 21 tests incl. the 4 new).
